questions.question: Which of the following is a correct description of asthma?
options: An infectious disease caused by a viral infection of the throat
A non-infectious disease that can cause breathing difficulties
A bacterial disease that can be treated with antibiotics
A lifestyle disease caused solely by a lack of exercise

questions.question: What physically happens to the respiratory system during an asthma attack?
options: The breathing (bronchial) tubes narrow
The alveoli completely fill with blood
The diaphragm becomes permanently paralyzed
The trachea expands to let in excess air

questions.question: How can the symptoms of asthma be treated when someone experiences breathing difficulties?
options: By injecting insulin into the muscle
By taking medication using an inhaler
By taking a course of oral antibiotics
By applying a topical skin ointment

questions.question: Infectious diseases are passed from one organism to another. What are they caused by?
options: Vitamins and minerals
Genes and inherited chromosomes
Pathogens including viruses and some bacteria
Tar and carbon monoxide

questions.question: Which of the following is true about non-infectious diseases?
options: They are always spread through airborne droplets.
They cannot be passed from one organism to another.
They are exclusively caused by bacterial infections.
They can be cured rapidly using antibiotics.

questions.question: Which of the following increases the risk of developing lifestyle diseases?
options: Eating a balanced diet and exercising regularly
Eating an unbalanced diet and not getting enough exercise
Getting plenty of sleep and drinking water
Avoiding processed foods and walking daily

questions.question: Which set of lifestyle factors can increase the risk of developing lifestyle diseases?
options: Reading, sleeping, and maintaining a balanced diet
Regular handwashing, vaccination, and outdoor walking
Smoking, drinking alcohol and using drugs
Stretching, drinking water, and taking vitamins

questions.question: Recreational drugs can be classified into which two main groups?
options: Infectious and non-infectious
Curative and preventative
Depressants or stimulants
Solvents and antibiotics

questions.question: What effect do depressants have on the body?
options: They speed up breathing and increase heart rate.
They slow down thinking and reaction times.
They cause immediate physical numbness in the limbs.
They increase alertness and physical strength.

questions.question: What is alcohol classified as, and what are the long-term health risks of its use?
options: A stimulant; causes lung cancer and asthma
A legal depressant; long-term use can damage the brain and liver
A solvent; causes immediate tooth decay
An antibiotic; destroys beneficial gut bacteria

questions.question: What is the effect of stimulants on a person's body?
options: They slow down heart rate and make the person drowsy.
They make you feel more alert and can give you quicker thinking and reaction times.
They act as pain relief medication to reduce swelling.
They induce deep sleep and lower body temperature.

questions.question: Which highly addictive substance is found in tobacco leaves?
options: Tar
Caffeine
Nicotine
Ethanol

questions.question: Smoking tobacco significantly increases the risk of developing which diseases?
options: Asthma, COPD, lung cancer and heart disease
Type 1 diabetes, hemophilia, and Down's syndrome
Malaria, cholera, and tuberculosis
Arthritis, food allergies, and eczema

questions.question: What is the term for inhaling chemicals, such as from glue or paint thinner, to become intoxicated?
options: Substance injection
Solvent abuse
Vaping therapy
Nicotine replacement

questions.question: What are the risks associated with solvent abuse?
options: Only short-term coughing with no lasting health risks
Improved lung capacity but mild headaches
Long-term health problems and a risk of death
Instant immunity to respiratory infections

questions.question: Which harmful, highly addictive substance is consumed when vaping, similar to smoking?
options: Carbon monoxide
Tar
Nicotine
Ethanol

questions.question: Which statement is true regarding the health effects of vaping?
options: They are fully understood and proven to be completely harmless.
The health effects of vaping are not yet fully known.
They have been shown to cure asthma and COPD.
They are identical in every way to drinking alcohol.
